body: BREAKING: Lil Durk @lildurk’s lawyers have filed an emergency motion before a verdict is reached in his trial. 👀 His defense is asking jurors to hear more of his 2023 interview with DJ Akademiks, arguing that prosecutors used a “misleading” excerpt during their rebuttal closing argument. His attorneys say the additional footage would provide context for his remarks. The filing also requests an alternative: a corrective instruction addressing the prosecution’s arguments and reminding jurors to base their decision on the evidence. The motion is a request from his defense and does not mean the judge has granted it.
